rework.closure:
Replaced the F-21.13-3 bullet in docs/testing/jellyfin-12-musl-test-host.md:467-477 (pre-edit lines) with the corrected root cause. The bullet no longer claims the administrator GET omits or filters the secret fields, and no longer instructs re-supplying secrets from a separate store. docs/testing/jellyfin-12-musl-test-host.md:476-491 now reads:
- **`POST /Plugins/{guid}/Configuration` replaces the whole configuration; never
  probe it with an empty or partial body (F-21.13-3, MEDIUM).** The
  elevation-gated save deserialises the request body into a fresh configuration
  object and the host assigns and persists it wholesale
  (`BasePlugin<TConfigurationType>.UpdateConfiguration`): the route replaces, it
  does not merge, so any field omitted from the body silently reverts to its
  default (both providers disabled, both API keys cleared, saved byte limits
  reset) while the endpoint still returns `204` with no warning and no
  activity-log entry. The task 21.13 run hit this while establishing the L2 `204`
  save with an empty-body `POST`; reconciliation stopped until the verifier
  re-supplied the provider `Enabled`/`BaseUrl`/`ApiKey` fields in the same POST.
  Never use an empty-body POST as a non-destructive 204 probe; always send a
  complete body. A `GET`→`POST` round-trip that carries the whole body is safe,
  because the administrator `GET` does return the provider `ApiKey` fields. The
  settings page avoids the trap because its password inputs leave the stored
  field untouched when the operator does not retype it.

known_limitations: F-21.13-2 (LOW, open): this run's contribution is the documented observation that a targeted POST /Items/{id}/Refresh?MetadataRefreshMode=FullRefresh&ImageRefreshMode=FullRefresh&ReplaceAllMetadata=false also re-adopts the sidecar and desynchronises the served image from the plugin's recorded active identity, the same class of divergence as a full POST /Library/Refresh. No OwnershipLost transition was observed in this run; the no-recovery substance (v1.2 exposes no in-product recovery trigger for an item whose active image content hash changes) is inherited unchanged from F-21.4-2 and is not re-established here. The owner-facing recovery path or an explicit out-of-band decision remains open for the release review/owner, and PLANS.md assigns no task to it.

F-21.13-3 (MEDIUM, open): Jellyfin's elevation-gated POST /Plugins/{guid}/Configuration performs whole-object replacement, so a partial or empty body silently resets every omitted field (providers disabled, keys and byte limits cleared) while returning 204; the task 21.13 run hit this while establishing the L2 204 save. The procedure now warns verifiers to always POST a complete body and never to use an empty-body POST as a non-destructive 204 probe. Whether the plugin should warn or reject a save that clears previously-set providers is a product decision, is not assigned to a later PLANS.md task, and is out of scope for this verification.

F-21.13-5 (MEDIUM, open): row L6 passes but is a no-regression check only. The pinned host is POSIX/musl and the committed fixture has no Cf-bearing media file name, so the live matrix cannot exercise the task 21.11 non-printing-scalar removal or the dual-separator final-component extraction; SEC-21.5-02/SEC-21.5-03 are established by the repository's LogSubject unit tests, not by this live matrix.
